subject: Follow-up: Scoped access-review export + SOC 2 bridge confirmation
messages:
From: Mike Andrews <mike.andrews@arcadiapartners.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: security+audit@arcadiapartners.com
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 bridge + targeted evidence request

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood’s hosted offering yesterday. Our compliance team asked for two follow-ups to close our internal assessment: a short SOC 2 Type II bridge letter covering July 1–Sep 30, 2025 (if available), and a scoped export of authentication events for the window Aug 1–Sep 1, 2025 showing MFA outcomes and privileged session starts.

Specifically they want: 
- A bridge letter stating no control changes relevant to auth occurred after the last SOC 2 report period.
- A CSV extract with timestamp, user_id, event_type (login_success/login_fail/mfa_challenge/mfa_success/privileged_session_start), source_ip, and session_id for the date range above.
- A short statement of whether access review reports (quarterly) include contractor/service accounts or only human users.

Can you confirm feasibility and an ETA? We have a compliance cutoff next Wednesday and would appreciate anything you can get us before then.

Best,
Mike
Mike Andrews
Sr. Security Manager | Arcadia Partners

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Mike Andrews <mike.andrews@arcadiapartners.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Sep 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 bridge + targeted evidence request

Hi Mike — thanks for the note and for the list; glad the demo was useful.

Short answers up front: we can provide a SOC 2 bridge letter for the requested window and a scoped auth-event CSV. The access-review scope needs a quick confirm internally (some teams include service/system accounts in the quarterly rollups). ETA: I can get a preliminary bundle by end of Friday (Sep 5) and a final export early next week if needed.

Would it be acceptable if we supply an initial sampling CSV (Aug 1–Aug 15) with the exact schema you requested to validate format, and then the full Aug 1–Sep 1 export once the sampling is approved? That will speed delivery.

I’ll loop in our security/compliance and the ops folks to pull the logs and confirm the access-review policy.

Regards,
Jasmine Liu
Manager, Trust & Compliance | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0129
